Smart home: daily challenge, 2027-02-16

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-02-16: Smart home. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

One million homes have a hub that keeps a live connection to your cloud. The hub reports its devices every few minutes, and the phone app sends commands like "lock the door". Commands must feel instant and must not be repeated. Once in a while a power cut ends and every hub reconnects together.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
